entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a black short-sleeved top, black trousers, and black shoes, with a dark striped headscarf and blue reflective glasses, and a dark band-like accessory visible on the wrist on the image-right side.

entities.name: Gray-white smoke
entities.identification: A large expanse of unevenly dense, light gray-white smoke surrounding Person A and partially occluding Person A and the light strips.

entities.name: Horizontal white light strip array

entities.name: Black reflective segmented floor
entities.identification: A nearly black floor covering the lower part of the image, with panel seams and broad areas of white reflection.

entities.name: Dark background
entities.identification: The nearly black background area exposed behind the smoke and light strips, excluding the floor, smoke, and light strip array.
